title: Check: StorageClasses
description: Five questions on provisioning volumes on demand.

options.text: Describes a kind of storage and the provisioner that creates it on demand
Limits how much storage a namespace may use

questions.explanation: It removes the need for an administrator to pre-create PVs: the PVC names a class and one appears.

questions.prompt: A PVC omits storageClassName entirely. What happens?

options.text: The cluster's default StorageClass is used, if one is marked as such
It binds to any free PV

questions.explanation: The annotation is storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class. With no default and no match, the PVC sits Pending.

options.text: Disable dynamic provisioning and bind only to a matching pre-created PV

questions.explanation: An explicit empty string is how you opt out of the default - not the same as leaving the field out.

options.text: Binding waits until a Pod using the PVC is scheduled

questions.explanation: Which is what keeps a zonal volume from being created in a zone where the Pod cannot run.

questions.prompt: Write the command that lists the StorageClasses in the cluster.
questions.explanation: The default one is marked '(default)' in the NAME column.
